svg.title: M02: an adapter asks, waits, acts and records at a verified model-request boundary
svg.desc: An agent request reaches the existing gateway boundary. Our adapter calls one evaluate interface. A stateless evaluator plus separate atomic coordinator return allow, deny or error. Approved requests require a dispatch guard before the model call. Policy is loaded before the run. Rich events and usage travel asynchronously to evidence ingestion, while minimal coordination state is durable. A log-only adapter cannot block.
svg.text: M02 · Where a proposed model call meets a control
Proposed inline integration · requires an actual pre-dispatch hook · logging alone cannot refuse a request

g.title: A particular model request, carrying trusted team/run/action/attempt context
The existing gateway passage and our attached adapter are different responsibilities
Model inference occurs only after durable reservation and a valid dispatch claim
Adapter honors the result and coordinator validates dispatch ownership
One synchronous application interface fronts a pure evaluator and separate atomic coordinator
g.text: Compare pinned rule with trusted state

g.title: Return allow, deny or error for this attempt
Policy register is loaded before the run; no registry request on each inference
g.text: Register stays off the request path

g.title: The already-loaded immutable policy is an input to evaluation
Coordinator state is durable; it is not hidden mutable evaluator memory
The coordinator commits a conditional transaction before returning permission
Event and outcome records are bound later to controls and specifications; transport acknowledgment is not control satisfaction
g.text: M05 ingestion → M06 workspace → control tests
Request, decision, dispatch, outcome, authoritative usage · reconcile missing facts
One record can support C7 and C16; Control 9 evaluates comparable windows separately

g.title: Recoverable transition records exported asynchronously to evidence processing

svg.text: ALLOW means this attempt may proceed under its conditions. It is not a declaration that the whole run satisfied Control 16.
If only logs are accessible: use emit / pull, retain complete accounting where possible, and make no preventive-enforcement claim.
